description: Start the independent Minutes real-time copilot for a goal. This launches `minutes copilot start`; MCP does not run model inference, own capture, or need to stay connected for the engine to produce nudges. The stdout surface is recommended for complete structured nudge observation. Docs: https://useminutes.app/docs/mcp/tools#tool-start_copilot

goal.description: Outcome the copilot should help achieve, for example 'land owners and deadlines'.

surface.description: CLI presentation surface. Use stdout for complete structured nudge reads; tui is compact text.

name: start_copilot
